answer.text: The stated annual interest rate paid on face value

explanation.text: The Logic: Coupon rate is a contractual rate paid on face value — fixed at issuance (for plain-vanilla bonds). The Trap: Market yield is separate; default is risk concept. Cross-Exam Context: Same in IV (IRD), X-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Distinguish coupon from YTM in client conversations — they're often confused.
